name: ExBluRF
aliases: Efficient Radiance Fields for Extreme Motion Blurred Images
definition: A novel view synthesis method for extreme motion blurred images that jointly optimizes sharp voxel-based radiance fields and 6-DOF camera trajectories to reconstruct blurry images via ray accumulation.
summary: ExBluRF reconstructs sharp 3D scenes from extreme motion blur by optimizing voxel-based radiance fields and Bézier camera trajectories, offering lower memory costs than MLP methods.
